scope: Manually specified source identity and withholding cases; not generated from importer output.
negative_cases: Different methods remain distinct even when their numbers are equal.
ID 2047 with number 958 and ID 2048 with number 957 are held, never guessed from the display name.
An unknown nutrient ID with number 957 is held when the supplied identifiers disagree.
The kcal methods reported with unit kJ are not converted or projected.
An energy method identified only by its display name is not promoted.
Ambiguous or conflicting rows of one method withhold that method's resolved point; the other method is retained independently.
Conversion factors never become nutrient amounts or authorize new energy/protein calculations.
The food publication string is retained without an inferred timezone, freshness or effective date.
CSV factor joins with an ambiguous food owner are held and retain raw rows.
legacy_policy: Method-specific rows do not populate the generic energyKcal field. A separately supplied legacy Energy 208 row retains its existing policy.
review: Frozen before production changes; official original archive and complete object remain available as ignored acquisition evidence.
